response.courseDescription: 341 Signals and Systems Discrete and continuous-time signals, LTI systems, convolution, sampling, Fourier transform, filtering, DFT, amplitude modulation, probability applications.
response.coursePrerequisites: E E 321 with a C or better; STAT 360 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment, or STAT 443 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; admitted to a major or minor in EECS, or major in Neuroscience.
